=== MAIN QUEST: The Tide and the Ember ===
Two old powers argue beneath this world: the Furnace and the Sea.
One reduces all it touches to ash.
One keeps its truths in cold, unbroken depths.
They do not teach.
They do not remind.
What endures is what you carry.
==========================================

Chapter 1: The Cinder Trail
Somewhere ahead, an old shrine still breathes beneath a coat of ash.
A mysterious guide mia_thompson knows how to lead you there.
Talk to mia_thompson about what to do next.
